rows.label: Childe Q

taskRootCount.eventDrivenTasks: OnTargetDied may schedule Riptide Burst task, requiring event ownership

rows.audit: Both stance branches queue one initial Hydro Q attack. Melee rtBlastCallback queues one Riptide Blast per eligible hit target; ranged applies Riptide. Init subscribes OnTargetDied and can queue Riptide Burst through a delayed task. C6 only sets melee burst reset state here.

rows.label: Ayato Q

Same callback may add normal-attack buff. C4 attack-speed buff and C6 normal attack follow-ups do not create Q attack roots. No recursion.
rows.gate: Require all 37 tagged tasks completed and all 36 dispatches terminal; later normal attacks and buff durations excluded.

rows.label: Wanderer Q

Windfavored OnRemoved only calls checkForSkillEnd on SwapState; skillEndRoutine deletes statuses/mods, resets points/CD and sets plunge availability; it queues no attack.
rows.gate: Existing analyzer blanket hasOnRemoved guard needs source-reviewed plan flag allowing this exact non-damage callback, while still rejecting animation queued callbacks. No extra method-entry count fact is needed.

scopeNotes: 两分支均直接排队五次Q攻击；仅对审阅后的Windfavored非伤害OnRemoved放行。

At 110f main task reads current BoL/C6 flat bonus and queues exactly one Q attack. Cooldown-reset and heal tasks queue no damage; A1 OnTargetDied changes debt, not attack.

rows.label: Lyney Q

taskRootCount.children: one first burstTick and one explosiveFirework registered by root; burstTick recursively registers one next tick while status active
taskRootCount.other: hat OnKill/OnExpiry is entity callback, not task root

rows.audit: Parent task creates status and tick+explosion children. Each burstTick queues one attack per newly eligible enemy (unbounded by current DSL), then one next tick while status active. ExplosiveFirework queues one attack if status active and creates hat; Q-created hat OnKill/OnExpiry queues Pyrotechnic Strike, and killing an older hat can emit another. Early Skill action can end the Q state.
rows.gate: Need native per-tick enemy loop count/keys, hat spawn/kill/expiry ownership and status/action cancellation event receipts. Fixed tick scheduling alone cannot certify full Q.

rows.label: Dehya E
rows.directRootCount: one in placement/recast branch, zero if Skill delegates to Q-mode UseBurstAction
rows.taskRootCount: field placement/pickup tasks are state-only; Q-mode delegates to separate burstPunch/burstKick tasks
rows.audit: Skill first calls UseBurstAction; while Burst/kick active this may queue a Q-mode punch/kick instead of E. Otherwise initial or recast E queues one direct attack and installs/moves field. Init skillDmgHook OnEnemyDamage may emit follow-up whenever an eligible later hit occurs within active field, subject to field/ICD/area/damage guards.
rows.gate: Full E needs native method-entry burstKey/kickKey/field/hasRecastSkill facts plus OnEnemyDamage trigger receipt linked to field instance. Initial placement hit may be a named partial scope only; do not call the field lifetime complete from a direct count of one.
rows.nonDamageMethodTasks: Initial/recast field placement one task, initial replacement optionally one pickup task; extra status deletion task may be registered by pickup.

rows.label: Dehya Q automatic chain
rows.audit: Burst schedules one initial task at 105f; it creates status and runs first punch. Successful punch queues one attack and either next auto punch (status still active) or kick (status ended); stale src or swapped actor returns with zero. Kick queues zero/one by same guards. C6 crit callback can extend burst status up to four 30f increments; no hardcoded punch count. Later N/E actions call UseBurstAction; Jump in a kick window queues a manual kick, otherwise cancels the burst and can increment burstHitSrc/queue manual Q-mode punches; these are independent action invocations and may stop the original auto chain. Dash only opens a 17f jump-to-kick window; the later Jump performs the manual kick/cancellation.
rows.gate: Scope is only Q-origin automatic punch chain and its final automatic kick; explicitly excludes later player N/E/J manual Q-mode actions and any E field proc. Require tagged chain completion; prohibit same-character Q overlap because burstHitSrc/burstCounter/status are shared. Runtime graph, no fabricated maxDepth or fixed hit count.

scopeNotes: 仅Q起始自动拳链与自动终踢；后续N/E/J输入的手动动作另算。src、前台和Q状态按原生运行时分支决定0/1及后继任务。

rows.nonDamageMethodTasks: If an E field was active, pickUpField registers one status-deletion task; successful automatic kick may register one field-restoration task. Neither queues a Q attack.

rows.label: Baizhu E
rows.audit: Initial direct Gossamer Sprite queues one attack. Its chain callback can queue next attack after each resolved enemy hit until count==3, or heal on no next target; callback has no once guard per multi-target dispatch. C2 OnEnemyDamage may queue Splice; C6 skill-hit callback summons shield whose later Spiritvein can attack.
rows.gate: Need hit-callback producer identity per parent attack/target, C2 event receipt, and C6 shield lifecycle ownership; a task-only graph or fixed 1..3 count would silently miss branches.
rows.nonDamageMethodTasks: Healing is scheduled by hit callback/skillHealing, not a direct damage producer from Skill method.
